pool.text: The Turks conquered Benghazi and it was ruled from Tripoli by the Karamanlis.
The front elevation of a building was completed in Benghazi.
Italy captured Benghazi and the rest of Tripolitania from the Ottoman Empire.
The Municipal palace was built in Maydan al-Hurriya in Benghazi.
The Berenice Cinema was designed by Marcello Piacentini and Luigi Piccinato.
The population of Benghazi was made up of more than 35 per cent Italians.
The city was captured from the Italians by Combe Force during Operation Compass.
Benghazi became the capital city of the Emirate of Cyrenaica under Idris Senussi I.
Cyrenaica was merged with Tripolitania and Fezzan to form the independent Kingdom of Libya.
Muammar Gaddafi staged a coup d'état causing Benghazi to lose its capital status.
The Tibesti Hotel on Gamal Abdel Nasser Street was built as the highest building.
The arena of football club Alahly Benghazi S.C. was demolished following anti-government protests.
An uprising against the government of Muammar Gaddafi occurred in the city.
The Libyan economy ministry announced plans for creating a free trade area in Benghazi.
A second civil war broke out in Libya between the House of Representatives and the Government.
The LNA's General Khalifa Haftar declared the city cleared of the Shura Council.
The 5+5 Joint Libyan Military Commission reached a permanent ceasefire agreement in all areas.
The Libyan Business Council set up the Benghazi International Trade Fair.
The military razed a large swath of Benghazi's historic center at night without notifying authorities.
